purpose: Add the __notestrTestArmAutoInvite window hook to MarmotProvider and a deterministic F2 regression e2e test that exercises the commit+app-message race via that hook.

public_api.name: __notestrTestArmAutoInvite
public_api.description: Test-only window hook installed by MarmotProvider when isTestRuntime() is true. Injects siblingKpEvent as if discovered by the auto-invite scan, triggering inviteByKeyPackageEvent on all loaded groups where the current user is admin and the KP is not already a leaf. Gated on isTestRuntime(). Deleted on MarmotProvider unmount.
